primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Backup restoration does not re-enable revoked users, secrets, or deleted data without detection.

controls.statement: Privacy deletion and backup-retention interactions are documented.
controls.primary_reason: Privacy deletion and backup-retention interaction rules can be required as a versioned documentation record; therefore the complete rule has an objective repeatable result with bounded authoritative evidence.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Privacy deletion and backup-retention interactions are documented.
